text: Start: two ideation cards, filesystem integration and embedding options. Reading existing research first.

Finding: caniuse puts File System Access pickers at 28.56 percent global, Firefox and Safari both no support, Mozilla position is 'harmful'. OPFS is 93.51 percent. So showDirectoryPicker cannot be the answer for this site.

Finding: the 2026-07-30 note's claim that Tauri/Electron webviews ignore X-Frame-Options is wrong as written. Both engines enforce it. Electron can strip headers via session.webRequest.onHeadersReceived; Tauri has no equivalent and its only path is native child webviews, which are OS rectangles set by setBounds and will not pan or zoom with the canvas. Writing both notes now.

Done. Two notes written: .agents/research/filesystem_integration_2026-08-01.md and .agents/research/embedding_options_firefox_app_distro_2026-08-01.md. Orchestrator: please link both from todo.md, I did not touch it. Side finding for the bug lane: preview-server.mjs listens on 0.0.0.0 and has zero uses of request.headers, so the write APIs take cross-origin POSTs and LAN POSTs with no Origin check.
